name: application-package-status-timeline
title: Package Status Timeline
description: Vertical timeline of package scan events with location, timestamp, and status, with the most recent scan styled as current — distinct from order-status-tracker's fixed-stage horizontal stepper, this models an open-ended sequence of real carrier scans.
useWhen: Showing the full scan history of a shipment (pickup, transit, delivery) with location and timestamp per event.
The number of tracking events is open-ended and carrier-driven, not a small fixed set of named stages.
The most recent scan should be visually emphasized as the current status.
avoidWhen: You only need a small, fixed set of stages (Placed/Shipped/Delivered) shown horizontally — use order-status-tracker instead.
You need a map visualization of the route, not a list of scans — use a dedicated shipment-tracking-map instead.
There's no location/timestamp data per event — a simpler activity-feed is enough.
responsiveBehavior: The timeline is a single-column vertical list; location and timestamp text wrap naturally under the status line at any width.
accessibility: The timeline is a real ordered list (<ol>) so assistive tech announces each scan's position and total count, in reverse-chronological order matching the data.
The current (most recent) scan is marked with both a larger/highlighted dot and bold status text, not color alone.
The connecting line between dots is decorative (aria-hidden); the list structure and status text carry the sequence.

variants.title: Package status timeline
variants.description: Four-scan shipment history from pickup in Portland to "Out for delivery" in Austin, with the latest scan highlighted, on a light surface.
accessibility: Events are expected in reverse-chronological order (most recent first), matching how carriers typically render tracking pages.

variants.title: Package status timeline (Dark)
variants.description: The same four-scan shipment history, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Dot, status, and location text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
